attach_cloudwatch_logs_policy.description: Controls whether CloudWatch Logs policy should be added to IAM role for Lambda Function

attach_policies.description: Controls whether list of policies should be added to IAM role

attach_policies_for_integrations.description: Whether to attach AWS Service policies to IAM role

attach_policy.description: Controls whether policy should be added to IAM role

attach_policy_json.description: Controls whether policy_json should be added to IAM role

attach_policy_jsons.description: Controls whether policy_jsons should be added to IAM role

attach_policy_statements.description: Controls whether policy_statements should be added to IAM role

aws_region_assume_role.description: Name of AWS regions where IAM role can be assumed by the Step Function

cloudwatch_log_group_kms_key_id.description: The ARN of the KMS Key to use when encrypting log data.

cloudwatch_log_group_name.description: Name of Cloudwatch Logs group name to use.

cloudwatch_log_group_retention_in_days.description: Specifies the number of days you want to retain log events in the specified log group. Possible values are: 1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, and 3653.

cloudwatch_log_group_tags.description: A map of tags to assign to the resource.

create.description: Whether to create Step Function resource

create_role.description: Whether to create IAM role for the Step Function

definition.description: The Amazon States Language definition of the Step Function

encryption_configuration.description: Not supported: ACK's StateMachine (sfn-controller v1.9.1) has no encryptionConfiguration field

logging_configuration.description: Defines what execution history events are logged and where they are logged

name.description: The name of the Step Function

number_of_policies.description: Number of policies to attach to IAM role

number_of_policy_jsons.description: Number of policies JSON to attach to IAM role

policies.description: List of policy statements ARN to attach to IAM role

policy.description: An additional policy document ARN to attach to IAM role

policy_json.description: An additional policy document as JSON to attach to IAM role

policy_jsons.description: List of additional policy documents as JSON to attach to IAM role

policy_path.description: Path of IAM policies to use for Step Function

policy_statements.description: Map of dynamic policy statements to attach to IAM role

publish.description: Determines whether to set a version of the state machine when it is created.

region.description: Region where the resource(s) will be managed. Defaults to the region set in the provider configuration

role_arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role to use for this Step Function

role_description.description: Description of IAM role to use for Step Function

role_force_detach_policies.description: Specifies to force detaching any policies the IAM role has before destroying it.

role_name.description: Name of IAM role to use for Step Function

role_path.description: Path of IAM role to use for Step Function

role_permissions_boundary.description: The ARN of the policy that is used to set the permissions boundary for the IAM role used by Step Function

role_tags.description: A map of tags to assign to IAM role

service_integrations.description: Map of AWS service integrations to allow in IAM role policy

sfn_state_machine_timeouts.description: Not supported: Terraform's create, update and delete timeouts: ACK retries until the state machine is synced, and Bundt waits for it

tags.description: Maps of tags to assign to the Step Function

trusted_entities.description: Step Function additional trusted entities for assuming roles (trust relationship)

type.description: Determines whether a Standard or Express state machine is created. The default is STANDARD. Valid Values: STANDARD | EXPRESS

use_existing_cloudwatch_log_group.description: Whether to use an existing CloudWatch log group or create new

use_existing_role.description: Whether to use an existing IAM role for this Step Function
